Description.value: The vanilla coop takes one kind of feed, needs a full game day to lay a single egg, three game days to raise one chicken, and can never give you meat. Worse, breeding is multiplied by zero, so a coop packed with hens still yields exactly one chick. This fixes all of it: butchering for meat and bones, breeding that scales with the flock, a rooster, six kinds of feed, six birds instead of three - nine with a Nesting Box - and eggs in eight hours instead of twenty-four. Server side only, no client install.
